what: Real-browser check of the side-panel extension, run by hand with scripts/check_side_panel.py
browser: Google Chrome 157.0.8103.40, throwaway profile, headless, 420 by 900
served_from: A local, unpushed combination made only for this check: the integration branch at 21eae2c, the redesign at a92f86c and the side-panel branch at ed80425, merged without conflict. The workspace was a fresh Northwind walkthrough started by scripts/setup_northwind.py with --side-panel-origin chrome-extension://kibophanbmnepbmhpampfagpjfhjfcnl --serve on port 8805.
extension: A copy of extension/ from the side-panel branch, differing only in the origin written in config.js (port 8805 instead of 8776). The manifest key and therefore the extension's ID are unchanged.
ramp: Not contacted. Every request to demo.ramp.com was answered by a local stub.

5_a_bill_with_no_saved_record.label: Ramp bill 11111111…
5_a_bill_with_no_saved_record.heading: No saved record for this bill

reading_the_result.1: The server names exactly the one extension origin in frame-ancestors.
reading_the_result.2: The extension loads under its pinned ID and frames the app at the records page.
reading_the_result.3: Sign-in works inside the frame with the test reviewer's file.
reading_the_result.4: With the saved bill's Ramp address in the active tab, the panel names the bill and shows its page: vendor, invoice, amount, that it is a saved read and not a live one, the person-posted note, and that Uptime has written nothing to Ramp. Nothing is wider than the panel.
reading_the_result.5: For a bill with no saved record the page says so and shows none of the other bill's facts.
reading_the_result.6: A tab on another site with the same path is not followed.
reading_the_result.7: A different page that tries to frame the app gets the browser's error page instead.

not_checked: the browser's side-panel container, which a person opens from the toolbar
loading into a person's own Chrome
any reviewer decision made inside the panel
